], dtype=float)

row_labels = ["Ad A", "Ad B", "Ad C"]
col_labels = ["Search", "Social", "Video"]

print("Payoff matrix A (Row's payoff; Column sees -A):")
print("rows =", row_labels)
print("cols =", col_labels)
print(A)
